title: DCM: const-ify some big data structures.
description:
The DCM tag/status/uid lookup tables are only ever read.  const-ifying them
moves about 210 kBytes of data to a read-only data section.

packet-dcm.h was regenerated using the make-packet-dcm.py script; Most of the
modifications in that file are a result of the updated source material.

notes.body:
> packet-dcm.h was regenerated using the make-packet-dcm.py script; Most of the modifications in that file are a result of the updated source material.

You might want to do that first, without any of the constification, and submit that, and then do the consitification on top of that, so as not to mix different changes.
